title: nan
authors: Wang T.-C.; Tsou L.-H.; Jhan J.-P.; Tang R.-S.
key_contribution: Presents a visual localization pipeline matching UAV imagery with satellite orthophotos/DSMs via SuperPoint, LightGlue, and spatial resection for GNSS-denied flight.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
